samples_reviewed.question_text: A long rectangle is cut across its width into two equal squares. What two shapes are made?
Two triangles are placed together, matching their longest straight edges. What shape do they form?
Two identical squares are placed side by side. What shape do they form?
A square is cut on a slant, from one corner to the opposite corner. What two shapes are made?
Two triangles are placed together, matching their longest straight edges. What shape do they form?
Two identical squares are placed side by side. What shape do they form?
A long rectangle is cut across its width into two equal squares. What two shapes are made?
Two identical triangles are joined along their matching straight edges to make a 4-sided shape with equal sides. What shape is formed?
Two identical triangles are rotated to fit together into a rectangle. What shape is made?
A rectangle is cut into two equal pieces down the middle. What two shapes are made?

competency_fulfillment.rationale: Composing and decomposing are both genuinely asked, but one composition item is under-determined: two triangles placed together, matching their longest straight edges is given a key of rectangle while square sits in the same option list, and nothing in that stem rules the square out. Seed 502 shows the generator can disambiguate by describing the result as a 4-sided shape with equal sides, which makes the looser stem a defect rather than an unavoidable ambiguity.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Both verbs of the competency are worked in both directions and all three shapes take part: triangles joined into a rectangle and into a square, squares joined into a rectangle, a rectangle cut into two squares, a square cut on a slant into two triangles, and a rectangle halved into two rectangles.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The language of cutting across its width and placing side by side is concrete and matches what a Grade 1 pupil does with paper shapes; no item requires imagining more than two pieces at once.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: The set alternates between items with a figure to inspect and items answered from the description alone, and it mixes joining actions with cutting actions and slant cuts with straight cuts, so presentation genuinely rotates rather than repeating one frame.

competency_alignment.rationale: Difficulty moves along a line that belongs to this competency - from naming the result of an obvious side-by-side join, to reading a diagonal cut, to recognising that two triangles can make either a rectangle or a square depending on the pieces.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Every composition and decomposition involves exactly two pieces, which is the level at which Grade 1 composing and decomposing of plane shapes is expected to operate.
